info.name: Abhyas Platform API Collection
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for testing the Abhyas E-Learning and Examination Platform APIs. Includes authentication, profile management, course enrollment, exams, questions, results, dashboard, notifications, leaderboard, and administrative management endpoints.

item.name: 1. Public & Auth
item.description: Unauthenticated APIs for registration, login, and password management.

item.name: 2. User Profile
item.description: Authenticated requests for user profile details.

item.name: 3. User Courses
item.description: Student APIs to explore and fetch enrolled courses.

item.name: 4. User Exams & Attempts
item.description: Core examination workflow: starting exam, managing questions/answers, and submitting.

item.name: 5. User Results & Analytics
item.description: Retrieve general scores, results by ID, and dashboard analytics.

item.name: Get Last Completed Result For Exam
6. User Dashboard
item.description: Endpoints to load the student dashboard components.

item.name: 7. User Notifications
item.description: List and update notification read status.

item.name: 8. User Leaderboard
item.description: Rankings sorted by scores across courses or individual exams.

item.name: 9. Admin User Management
item.description: Admin APIs to view and remove user records.

item.name: 10. Admin Course Management
item.description: Admin APIs to perform CRUD on course items.
